name: Model picker
oneLiner: a glass chat composer: the model pill is pressed, a menu of models with generic glyph tiles opens up out of it, a lit hover plate glides down to the pick, it presses with a ring and takes the check, the menu folds away and the pill rolls to the new name and flips its glyph while the placeholder updates
say: when the speaker says which model to use or to switch ('switch it to the bigger model', 'pick the one that thinks longer'): the menu opens on 'switch', the pick presses on the model they name, the pill updates as they say why
